$comment: Judges are pluggable: add an entry with a type the harness implements. Prices are list prices per million tokens. A run with judgePricing list-price reserves each call's worst case at these prices; covered-by-plan reserves nothing and halts on any charge the judge reports.

morph-kimi-k3.1-pro.label: Kimi K3.1 Pro via Morph

sources.covers: base URL, bearer auth, MORPH_API_KEY, model id morph-kimik31, reasoning_effort values, list prices
Ultra removes the token meter on Kimi K3.1; per-minute token limits; 429 with Retry-After
temperature and top_p are fixed for K3.1 and should be omitted; reasoning always on and billed as output

unverified: Whether max_tokens bounds reasoning tokens for this model on Morph. The budget assumes it does and halts the run on any overrun.
Whether response_format json_schema is honoured for this model. The parser also accepts a bare JSON object in the text.
The usage field names (prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) are the OpenAI convention; Morph's pages do not show a Kimi response body.

Under the Ultra plan the marginal cost is $0, so the owner's configs set judgePricing covered-by-plan. Morph's pages do not show how a charge would be reported; the judge reads usage.cost and usage.total_cost and treats a 402 as a charge, and either halts a covered run.

morph-deepseek-v4.1-flash.label: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash via Morph

sources.covers: model id morph-dsv41flash (not the gated morph-dsv41flash-abliterated); reasoning on by default; JSON schema requests disable reasoning; reasoning_effort values
Ultra covers morph-dsv41flash with no token meter; 400,000 input and 70,000 output tokens per minute
list prices $0.12 input, $0.80 output per million tokens

unverified: Whether the host fixes temperature and top_p for this model; they are not sent, so the host default applies to both judges alike.
Morph documents that JSON schema output disables reasoning for DeepSeek, so this judge reasons only in its written rationale; no reasoning_effort is sent.
The usage field names and charge reporting are assumed to match the primary judge's; any reported charge or a 402 halts a covered run.
